verdict.rationale: The SDK's entire interaction model is natural-language: queries/prompts drive Claude's agent loop, ClaudeSDKClient supports natural-language chat interfaces, and streaming input mode enables rich conversational interactions including clarifying questions via AskUserQuestion. This is core, well-documented functionality directly matching the story.
